Utility operations for system information and data management.

This command group provides utility operations:
  Common operations: version, migrate, validate-yaml, fix-hashes
  Specialized operations: (future: export, import, etc.)

  Show version
  zqk.test utility version
  Migrate data
  zqk.test utility migrate --from file --to graph
  Validate YAML
  zqk.test utility validate-yaml file.yaml
  Fix hashes
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --recursive docs/process/

Usage:
  zqk.test utility [command]

Available Commands:
  fix-hashes       Fix missing or mismatched integrity hashes
  fix-registration Fix registration issues (ID format mismatches)
  migrate          Migrate data between backends
  scenario-builder Build test scenarios with configurable data
  validate-yaml    Validate YAML file syntax
  version          Show ZQK version information

Use "zqk.test utility [command] --help" for more information about a command.
